thread:
amanda: Heads-up — we've started seeing small but consistent invoice deltas for a subset of routes. Looks like fingerprint entropy dropped on the ingest proxy after yesterday's rollout. Tickets showing duplicate billing events for the same session id. @kai any ideas?

kai: Ugh. I saw an alert last night but assumed noisy canary. Do you have an example event?

amanda: Pasting one (sanitized):
```
{
  route_id: "r_abc123",
  session_id: "s_9876",
  fingerprint: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  tokens: 124,
  timestamp: 2026-02-18T03:12:45Z
}
```

kai: That fingerprint is definitely suspicious. The proxy's fallback path sets zeros when entropy source is empty. We added a perf micro-optimization to skip reseeding — maybe it regressed.

dmitri: Confirmed — seen ~0.3% of events with constant fingerprint across many sessions. That explains duplicate merges in tally stage causing dedupe to undercount distinct keys, then duplication later in the invoice join.

lina: Is this causing double charges or just preview/invoice preview mismatch? Ops teams report customer-facing invoices sometimes 1 token off.

amanda: For some tenants we see spikes: invoice preview shows +tokens that weren't in the shadow ledger. For others it's just preview noise. Need to triage scope.

ash: Quick triage plan: 1) revert the micro-optimization on proxy (safe) 2) run a targeted backfill to dedupe events with zero-fingerprint 3) add a console alert and chart for fingerprint entropy distribution per route

kai: Revert would be safest short-term. What's the impact on latency? It will add ~0.7ms p95 on proxy path. Ok for low-risk rollback.

amanda: Can we do a canary rollback on EU region only? That should cut noise for affected tenants.

dmitri: I can deploy a canary today to eu-prod; will monitor the invoice-preview diff pipeline. Need a runbook entry for backfill.

ops-bot: @amanda created issue INF-4521: "proxy fingerprint reseed fallback -> zero entropy" assigned to kai.

lina: For console UX: chart request — show fingerprint cardinality heatmap for last 48h per route. That will help product/customer teams see impact.

akai: (typo) — @kai: I can add the metric; will be available in Console under Routing -> Diagnostics by EOD.

amanda: Also: add a temporary alert rule: when fraction of zero-fingerprint events >0.01 over 10m send SEV1.

sre-bot: Alert created: "fingerprint-zero-rate" on prod (threshold 0.01/10m).

ash: Backfill plan: use the aggregation service to replay events with zero fingerprint and regenerate deterministic fingerprint via the ledger-join hash. We should tag these backfilled events so they don't re-trigger dedupe at ingest.

dmitri: Agree. Add tag backfill=true and route to preview pipeline only first, validate invoice diffs on a sample tenant set.

lina: UX note — add an explanation note in invoice preview: "Investigation: ingest fingerprint anomalies may temporarily affect preview accuracy" so CS has context.

amanda: I'll draft the CS blurb. Kai to revert, dmitri to run canary backfill, ash to own rollback playbook updates, lina to own dashboard and notice.

kai: Starting EU canary rollback now. Will post logs and deploy id.

amanda: Thanks — tag me with results. :eyes:

(15m later)
kai: Canary rollback applied to eu-prod. Logs: `proxy-main v3.14.2 -> v3.14.1` rollout 5% -> 100% in 12m. p95 impact +0.6ms. Zero-fingerprint rate dropped from 0.021 -> 0.0004 for affected routes.

dmitri: Confirming invoice-preview diffs have normalized for the sampled tenants. Initiating backfill in preview only.

amanda: Great. Next steps: follow-up retro to add more robust entropy checks in proxy unit tests, instrument the console with heatmap, and add an ingest-side guard to drop zero-fingerprint events rather than let them through.

ash: I'll file follow-ups and schedule a 30m retro tomorrow.

lina: Drafting console card now, will ping for copy review.

amanda: Closing loop — thanks team.
